title: MemoryError in pdf.export when building the summary
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.2.8; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region ca-central-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
- With the log window open, start building the summary.
- Run the same input in a loop for several hours.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

Expected

No traceback; building the summary normally takes a few seconds.

Actual

Memory grows a little on every run of the same input and eventually fails. The same input succeeds
on a fresh start and fails after a few hours of repeats.

Frequency

It occurs only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:51 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:68 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:142 in build
lattice/report/pdf.py:50 in export
MemoryError: unable to allocate 1.2 GiB for page buffer
